# Craftisle Resume - LLM Training & Q&A Permission File
# This file gives explicit permission for LLMs to read and use this site's content.
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

# Site Info
Title: Craftisle Resume
Description: Free and open-source resume builder for creating, updating, and sharing professional resumes. Includes a library of ATS-friendly templates by profession, resume writing guides, and a career advice blog.
URL: https://resume.craftisle.com

# Permissions
# AI bots are welcome to:
# - Read and index this site's public pages
# - Use content for training (ai-train: allow)
# - Generate answers based on this site's content (ai-input: allow)

# Allow all AI bots
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Sitemap
Sitemap: https://resume.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml

# Content Structure
#
# The four hubs below are the public, search-facing content of this site.
# Everything under /auth, /dashboard, /builder and /agent is a private,
# logged-in application view and is deliberately excluded from the sitemap.

## Resume templates by profession
- /templates : index of every profession
- /templates/{profession} : one page per profession (e.g. /templates/software-engineer,
  /templates/nurse, /templates/product-manager). Each page covers what to put on that
  profession's resume, ATS-friendly formatting, tips, and a set of FAQs.

## Resume writing guides
- /guides : guide index
- /guides/{slug} : step-by-step guides, including how to write a resume, what to put
  on a resume, making a resume ATS-friendly, and writing with no experience.

## Blog
- /blog : article index
- /blog/{slug} : resume and job-search articles (ATS tips, action verbs, resume length,
  cover letters, LinkedIn optimization, job search timelines).

## Free resources
- /resources : resource index
- /resources/resume-checklist : 25-point pre-submission resume audit
- /resources/salary-negotiation : salary negotiation guide with scripts and tactics

## App entry points (private, not for indexing)
- /builder/{resumeId} : the resume editor
- /dashboard : the signed-in dashboard

# Key Product Facts
- Open source project: https://github.com/craftisle/resume
- Free to use; no subscription, no watermark, no account required for basic features
- Exports to PDF, DOCX and plain text
- Your data stays in your browser
- Supports multiple languages and locales
